content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Start digital

Your sovereign digital commerce stack is not a workaround for platform restrictions but a base-layer infrastructure that gives you full control over your online store, payment processing, and data ownership. This infrastructure is designed to work even when platforms fail, ensuring that you can continue selling digital products without interruptions. By using GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages, or a similar service for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, you can create a fully functional e-commerce platform that is not dependent on any third-party service.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your sovereign digital commerce stack, you need a digital product to sell, a cryptocurrency wallet to receive payments, and a NOWPayments account to integrate with your store. You also need to choose the deployment method, whether it's using the Sovereign Starter Stack, Edge Commerce Stack, or Complete Builder Kit. The Complete Builder Kit includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates, which can be instantly downloaded and used to build, deploy, and scale your sovereign digital commerce stack.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Setting up your payment and delivery pipeline involves integrating NOWPayments with your store and configuring the automatic on-chain crypto payment verification process. This process ensures that payments are verified in real-time, and the digital product is delivered to the customer immediately after the payment is confirmed. You can also set up automated email notifications to keep your customers informed about the status of their orders.

A sovereign digital commerce stack is not a workaround for platform restrictions but a base-layer infrastructure that gives you full control over your online store, payment processing, and data ownership.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Going live with your sovereign digital commerce stack involves deploying your store and configuring the payment and delivery pipeline. To process your first transaction, you need to create a test payment and check that the payment is processed correctly and the digital product is delivered to the customer. Once you have verified the payment and delivery process, you can go live with your store and start accepting payments from customers.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Scaling a sovereign digital store requires no infrastructure changes at any realistic volume level for most individual creators. Cloudflare Workers processes each webhook event independently — ten simultaneous orders are handled as ten separate processes with no queue congestion. Supabase handles hundreds of concurrent database operations on the free tier. Resend delivers 3,000 emails per month on the free tier — enough for significant daily sales volume. Cloudflare Pages serves the storefront to any number of concurrent visitors without capacity constraints. NOWPayments processes payment volume without per-transaction approval delays.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The most important question to answer is: Can I sell digital products without relying on platforms like Stripe, PayPal, or Gumroad? The answer is yes. With a sovereign digital commerce stack, you can create a fully functional e-commerce platform that is not dependent on any third-party service, giving you full control over your online store, payment processing, and data ownership.
Selling digital products with a sovereign digital commerce stack can save you up to $921 per month in platform fees, depending on your sales volume and product prices.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking for a comprehensive solution to sell digital products without platform fees, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) is the perfect starting point. This kit includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates that you need to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack. You can also shop for other products on our website at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy your sovereign digital commerce stack, follow these steps: Create a NOWPayments account and integrate it with your store; Choose the deployment method, whether it's using the Sovereign Starter Stack, Edge Commerce Stack, or Complete Builder Kit; Configure the automatic on-chain crypto payment verification process; Set up automated email notifications to keep your customers informed about the status of their orders; Deploy your store and go live; Monitor the performance of your store and payment pipeline, and make adjustments as needed to ensure that the system can handle increased traffic and payment volumes.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I set up a NOWPayments account?

To set up a NOWPayments account, simply visit the NOWPayments website and follow the registration process. You will need to provide some basic information about yourself and your business, and then verify your email address and phone number. Once you have completed the registration process, you can integrate your NOWPayments account with your store and start accepting payments from customers.
What is the difference between the Sovereign Starter Stack and the Edge Commerce Stack?

The Sovereign Starter Stack is a basic deployment package that includes GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages, and NOWPayments, while the Edge Commerce Stack is a more advanced deployment package that includes Cloudflare Pages, Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments. The Edge Commerce Stack is designed for larger businesses and high-traffic stores, while the Sovereign Starter Stack is better suited for smaller businesses and low-traffic stores.
Can I sell digital products using a credit card payment gateway?

No, you cannot sell digital products using a credit card payment gateway. To use a credit card payment gateway, you need to have a merchant account with a bank, which is not possible in countries where Stripe, PayPal, or Gumroad are not available. Instead, you can use a cryptocurrency payment gateway like NOWPayments, which allows you to accept payments in any cryptocurrency and convert them to USD or other fiat currencies in real-time.
How do I deliver digital products automatically after payment?

To deliver digital products automatically after payment, you need to configure the automatic on-chain crypto payment verification process using NOWPayments. This process involves setting up a webhook that triggers the delivery of the digital product to the customer after the payment is confirmed. You can also set up automated email notifications to keep your customers informed about the status of their orders.
Can I use a self-hosted email service like Mailgun or Sendgrid?

Yes, you can use a self-hosted email service like Mailgun or Sendgrid to send automated email notifications to your customers. This is a good option if you want to have full control over your email infrastructure and don't want to rely on a third-party email service provider.
How do I monitor the performance of my store and payment pipeline?

To monitor the performance of your store and payment pipeline, you can use the analytics and data provided by NOWPayments, as well as any third-party analytics tools that you may be using. You can also use Cloudflare's built-in analytics tools to monitor the performance of your store and make adjustments as needed to ensure that the system can handle increased traffic and payment volumes.

A cryptocurrency payment gateway like NOWPayments is the perfect solution for businesses that need to accept payments in any cryptocurrency and convert them to USD or other fiat currencies in real-time.
